summary: Iteration 4 backend regression + targeted verification of the two iter-3 fixes for KG Vac Service Job Manager. 63 passed, 3 skipped (pre-existing TEST_ user-state skips in TestUserManagement — not regressions), 0 failures. Added 3 new tests under TestOverdueDateRangeMerge (overdue + wide range includes, overdue + future-only range excludes, overdue + narrow past range includes) and 2 new tests under TestSeedPasswordIdempotency. Explicitly validated RESEED_PASSWORDS=true behavior end-to-end: changed staff2's password out-of-band, confirmed seed login returned 401 and mutated password returned 200 before restart; restarted backend via supervisorctl; confirmed seed login returned 200 and mutated password returned 401 after restart — reseed-on-boot is working. The overdue+date_range merge fix at server.py:790-794 is verified: $lt (now) and $gte/$lte (range) now coexist on scheduled_at correctly.

minor.issue: Pre-existing from iter 3. Backend logs still show 'Email send failed: Client error 422 unknown' for Emergent email integration during forgot-password / assignment / status-change flows. Does not crash any endpoint (caught by try/except) but means emails are silently not delivered in this preview env. Main agent noted a direct curl returned 202; may be payload-shape or env-specific. Non-blocking.
Pre-existing. EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder in backend/.env causes every push to return 401 'invalid X-Push-Key'. Swallowed by exception handler. Non-blocking.

action_items: Both iter-3 regressions are fixed and verified. No new backend action items required.
(Carried over, non-blocking) Investigate 422 from Emergent email /email/send and set a real EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY for push delivery.
(Carried over) Consider modularising server.py (now 1049 lines) into routers for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:473-497 seed_data() correctly reseeds admin+staff1+staff2 password_hash and increments token_version when RESEED_PASSWORDS=true — upsert-on-boot pattern is idempotent and self-heals test drift. Verified by out-of-band mutation + restart.

server.py:781-794 list_jobs — overdue filter sets {status:$in, scheduled_at:{$lt:now}}, then date range block reads existing query['scheduled_at'] dict and merges $gte/$lte into it instead of overwriting — fix is correct.
server.py:947 dashboard overdue count uses the same {$lt:now} + status $in semantics as list_jobs, keeping counts and list consistent.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_kgvac_backend.py (appended TestOverdueDateRangeMerge with 4 tests incl. cleanup, and TestSeedPasswordIdempotency with 2 end-of-run seed-login assertions)
seed_data_creation: Reused TEST_-prefixed customers, categories, jobs. New test class TestOverdueDateRangeMerge now self-cleans by cancelling its overdue_merge_job at end of class so re-runs don't accumulate overdue state (one-time repair applied for leftovers from the first run of this iteration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `-n 0` (serial) to respect module-level STATE sharing — the pytest.ini defaults to -n 2 loadscope which breaks because the shared STATE dict isn't visible across xdist worker processes. Example: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -n 0 -v`. All 63 tests should pass; the 3 skips in TestUserManagement are because prior iterations created TEST_newuser@example.com in a certain state and the suite short-circuits (not a bug). The TestChangePassword test now targets staff2 but reverts in-run; combined with RESEED_PASSWORDS=true, cross-iteration drift is self-healing. If you need to verify reseed end-to-end: mutate a seed password, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, then login with seed creds (works) and mutated creds (401).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iter-3 fixes validated. For completeness: initial run on second pass flagged one failure (dashboard overdue staff2 == 1 instead of 0) because my TestOverdueDateRangeMerge created a new overdue job for staff2 and didn't cancel it, so a second pytest run would see the orphan job before cleanup. Resolved by adding test_cleanup_overdue_merge_job that cancels the created job at the end of the class and manually cancelling 2 leftover TEST_OverdueMerge jobs via admin API. Suite is now stable across repeated runs (verified 2 clean consecutive runs).
